fix(ci): keep release dependencies and lockfile in sync (#141)

The publish job stops at `pnpm i` with `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE`
after the release PR updates `packages/cli/package.json`. Its self dev
dependency is `@swc/cli@0.8.2`, while the lockfile still resolves
`0.8.0`. Version `0.8.2` is not yet on npm, so resolving that dependency
would also block its own release.

Use `workspace:*` for the CLI self dev dependency and regenerate the
lockfile. This links the local CLI and removes the old registry CLI
dependency tree. Update the Changesets version command to refresh the
lockfile after version changes so future release PRs include it. The
initial CI install still uses the frozen lockfile.
